form.title: Join a branch near you
form.intro: Tell us a little about yourself and which branch you would like to help. A branch coordinator reads every application personally and will get in touch.
form.privacy: We use your contact details only to reply about this application. They are never shown publicly or shared outside the branch team.

fullName.label: Full name
fullName.hint: The name you would like the branch to call you.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: We will send our reply here.

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: A Pakistani mobile number, for example <ltr>0300 1234567</ltr>.

message.label: Anything you would like us to know
message.hint: Your skills, the time you can give, or why you want to join. Up to 1,000 characters.

branch.label: Branch
branch.hint: Only branches currently welcoming volunteers are listed.

errors.too_short: This looks too short. Please enter at least 2 characters.
errors.too_long: This is longer than we can accept. Please shorten it.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a Pakistani mobile number, like <ltr>0300 1234567</ltr> or <ltr>+92 300 1234567</ltr>.
errors.invalid_branch: Please choose a branch from the list.
errors.summary: {count, plural, one {Please check one answer before sending} other {Please check # answers before sending}}
errors.duplicate: You have already applied to this branch and your application is still being reviewed. We will be in touch soon.
errors.rateLimited: We have received several applications from this connection. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side and your application was not sent. Your answers are still here, so please try again.
errors.noBranchesTitle: No branches are open right now
errors.noBranches: No branch is taking new volunteers at the moment. Please check back soon.

thanks.title: Thank you, your application is with us
thanks.body: A coordinator from the branch will read it and contact you by email or phone. There is nothing else you need to do for now.

steps.read: A branch coordinator reads your application.
steps.contact: They contact you to talk about where you can help.
steps.welcome: Once you are accepted, the branch welcomes you as a member.
